description: Distributor handles {:coverage_demand, tag}: pick node via coordinator service directory capabilities -> that node's Foreman starts materializer worker -> epoch lock/unlock (existing recovery machinery, single authority) -> TSL delta to Director (A4) -> {:covered, tag, pid} to placeholder. Backoff on failure; telemetry for demand/spin-up duration/park/shed counts. Read-version handoff: recruited materializer replays to current; version_too_old after long spin-up is acceptable client-retry.

comments.text: Note from q67.1: StorageRacing's rescue currently conflates 'uncovered shard' and 'key outside keyspace' into layout_lookup_failed. When wiring coverage demand, consider replacing the rescued raise with a structured {:error, {:uncovered_shard, tag, range}} so the placeholder/Distributor path gets the tag without re-lookup.

From q67.2 audit (wire when adding recruitment): (1) no retry when distributor start genuinely fails — Process.send_after retry; (2) no backoff on re-recruit — crash-looping distributor restarts at full speed; (3) log older-epoch notify_epoch_change as suspicious; (4) consider skipping re-recruit on DOWN reason == :normal once epoch notification is wired (stale-epoch re-recruit is currently self-limiting but wasteful).

title: On-demand materializer recruitment flow
